'''Downtown Central''' was an area located in [[District 1327]] of [[Zakuul]]. In [[3631 BBY]] [[Senya Tirall]] and [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]] passed it during their search for the [[SCORPIO|Lady of Sorrows]].<ref name="KotFE 7" />

==Behind the scenes==
Downtown Central appears as an area on Zakuul in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' expansion.<ref name="KotFE 7" />

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' {{1st}}
